description: Extended math helpers for std/math that remain inside Z3-friendly integer arithmetic. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/extended — verified extended math'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm and std/math/*.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Avoid quantifiers and unbounded recursion; use only integer comparisons, conditionals, addition, subtraction, multiplication under explicit bounds, and division under explicit non-zero preconditions.
implementation_notes: Prefer saturating or caller-bounded contracts over raw overflow-prone arithmetic.
Do not introduce floating point types or transcendental functions.
Mean and distance helpers should expose bounded i64 facts that downstream finance and control modules can reuse.

atoms.name: signum_i64
atoms.description: Return -1 for negative inputs, 0 for zero, and 1 for positive inputs.

atoms.name: square_bounded
atoms.description: Square a caller-bounded non-negative input and prove the result remains under an explicit limit.

atoms.name: mean_floor_nonneg
atoms.description: Compute the floor mean of two non-negative values under explicit addition bounds.
atoms.requires: a >= 0 && b >= 0 && max_sum >= 0 && a + b <= max_sum

atoms.name: abs_distance_i64
atoms.description: Return a non-negative distance between two bounded signed integers.
atoms.requires: limit >= 0 && a >= -limit && a <= limit && b >= -limit && b <= limit && limit <= 4611686018427387903
